newsitem.title: THAILAND: Big five Thai finance shrs soar on merger deadline.
newsitem.headline: Big five Thai finance shrs soar on merger deadline.

text.p: Stocks of five large Thai finance and securities firms leading the consolidation of the industry soared shortly after opening on Friday, traders said.

The stocks pushed their daily 10 percent trading ceilings. Krungthai Thanakit Plc added 2.25 to 28.50 baht, Dhana Siam Plc put on 2.25 to 27.50, Phatra Thanakit Plc gained 2.25 to 45.00, Nava Finance and Securities Plc was up 1.25 to 18.50 and National Finance and Securities Plc gained 2.00 to 29.75 by 0333 GMT.
The central bank has said the firms could receive commercial bank licences for helping to rescue 16 ailing firms.
